cases.title: Spot right, P&L wrong
cases.marketSetup: USDJPY rises 0.9%; 1M implied volatility falls 1.2 vol points.
cases.portfolio: Net long USDJPY delta and long short-dated vega.

referenceAnswer.mystery: Long-vega losses from the vol decline more than offset delta gains.
referenceAnswer.evidence: Favorable spot, adverse vol, known long vega.
referenceAnswer.nextCheck: Check delta/vega attribution by tenor and theta.
referenceAnswer.residual: Theta or small gamma effects may remain.
